results.query: Can a delayed physical equipment request or receipt fire a replaced, dropped or cancelled tool, and how is the worker queue bounded?
results.bounded_answer_from_saved_context: Pending physical equipment work is bounded to eight requests and one pending/in-flight request per actor. Cancellation retires requests and late results and is serialized with bounded material consumption. Already launched projectiles/devices have their own lifetime. The retrieved set does not spell out the complete issued-observation/equipment identity envelope, so I would not implement a replacement-safe protocol from it alone.
results.assessment: The bounded answer matches worker admission/cancellation and session guards. Exact usable_index/instance_id/equipment_epoch plus run/request/body/lease identity is absent; the16-command liquid-apparatus queue at rank5 is a separate subsystem and must not replace the physical8-request limit.
